title: Concept: Pod spec referenced over cleartext
description: Podfile declares a `podspec` URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `podspec` URL over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Podfile (cocoapods).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `podspec` URL over cleartext.
